title: Garsa Fwip
description: As the Twi'lek proprietor of Garsa's Sanctuary in Mos Espa, Garsa Fwip was an elegant, lavishly dressed, and incredibly charming operator on Tatooine. She paid her dues to the Daimyo on Jabba the Hutt's throne—whether that was Jabba, Bib Fortuna, or Boba Fett—without complaint, though she still suffered as a bystander in the gang war.
